verdict.rationale: Zep's concepts docs list a Custom Entity/Edge Types feature that uses Pydantic-like classes to customize how entities and relations are created and retrieved. The Graphiti repo also says it supports both prescribed and learned ontology. An older HN thread (zep-comm-3) records devs calling custom schema a high priority but not yet implemented; that dates from before the feature shipped and does not contradict the current documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing how to define and register custom types and their limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of domain ontology customization.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain

citations.quote: Custom Entity/Edge Types | Feature allowing use of Pydantic-like classes to customize creation/retrieval of entities and relations in the Context Graph.
